title: 2027 Prairie's brick barn on the alley
items: The barn behind 2027 Prairie Avenue is no longer a rough draft. It now stands as a two-storey brick barn, 14.5 m along the alley and 10.7 m deep, drawn from the 1911 fire-insurance map. The rough draft was smaller, at 12.8 m by 9.8 m.

A fire wall stands at the north end, against the neighbour's building. Two carriage doors, a hay-loft hatch and a paired window face the alley, the window where the map marks one. A paved walk leads from the yard door to the house's back porch.
The doors, roof pitch and most windows are reconstructed, and they are listed on the building's card.
